lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I know this is sudden,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: but there's somewhere I want to go with you.
Where is it?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: It's a place where they have what people are calling precision karaoke.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Apparently it's all the rage lately.
Is that different from regular karaoke?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Ordinary karaoke is all well and good,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: but precision karaoke

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: analyzes the singer's intonation and pitch in great detail.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: It then takes those factors, and others, into consideration,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: and gives you a score that indicates your musical ability.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I thought it would be fun if you and I went.
Why don't you ask the Prima Donna Squad?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: No way! They're all professional singers.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: wanted to go up against you.
But I can't carry a tune to save my life.
Prepare to be amazed by my golden voice.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: So what?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: It's only going to be me listening.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Oh my, such confidence!

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I'm looking forward to this, hehe.
Will this be your first time going?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Oh, hehe...

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Actually, I went by myself a couple of days ago.
What was your score?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Lol

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: 9 points.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Isn't that amazing?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: 9 out of 10 is pretty darn good!
I think it may have been out of 100...

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: We should go together next time.
Okay, let's do that.
